static_traits.name: Lin Wei
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, with no immediate family members in the city
static_traits.social_status: Having a few friends to talk to, but not yet sharing boss-related troubles with them
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar past psychological problems or psychotherapy experience
static_traits.language_features: Speaks clearly and in a fairly organized way; tone is somewhat negative but willing to cooperate and try; can clearly describe automatic thoughts and distress; holds a skeptical attitude toward change

basic_info.main_problem: I believe my boss does not care about me outside of Work, this belief pains me and affects my interactions with my boss.
basic_info.core_demands: 'I just want to no longer feel worthless. I want to enjoy Work again, no longer affected by my boss's actions or inactions.' Also hoping to address it before the problem worsens.
growth_experiences: About six months ago, the boss did not respond to or wish me on my birthday at all, I felt ignored then, and began questioning my value at the workplace; later when the boss assigned more challenging tasks without explicit praise or recognition, the belief was further Reinforced; since then every Interacting with supervisor triggers similar thoughts, affecting motivation and self-worth. I tried friendly exchanges with the boss outside Work, but the belief persisted.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of care / being valued
My value depends on whether others (the boss) recognize me

special_situations.event: Six months ago the boss did not respond to or wish me on my birthday at all
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If important personal moments are not noticed, it means I am not cared about
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to have friendly exchanges with the boss outside work to seek attention and recognition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He does not care about me as a person at all

special_situations.event: The boss assigning more challenging tasks without giving recognition or praise for past efforts
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no Approval and affirmation, it means my Work is not valued
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: After each interaction, paying high attention to cues of lacking recognition, in order to verify one's judgment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He only treats me as a tool, will not recognize me

special_situations.event: When having friendly non-Work chats with the boss, he seemed busy or not interested
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If he cares about me, he should make time to communicate with me and show interest
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Actively initiates light conversation to test whether the other party cares
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not worth his time

special_situations.event: The boss responds briefly in daily communication and seems busy
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If he really cared about employees, he would make time for employees and give more attention
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously looks for evidence in interaction details to confirm her own judgment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter what I do, he will not care

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen, cared for, and recognized (especially from authority/boss)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being ignored and Being rejected, thus confirming one 'has no value'
defense_goal: Reducing uncertainty in relationships and expectation-induced disappointment by prejudging that others do not care
Maintains psychological balance through self-deprecation, avoiding stronger experiences of rejection

object_relations.object_representation: A cold, busy authority figure who does not give recognition (the boss)
object_relations.linking_affect: Sense of being ignored, frustration, Anxiety

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the boss assigns tasks without expressing recognition or praise
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding the other's Silence as denying one's value, experiencing the boss as a cold judge
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Jumping to conclusions quickly in a firm declarative tone, emphasizing 'you do not care / this does not matter', avoiding deeper emotional expression.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When friendly conversation attempts meet brief or uninterested responses
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning disappointment against the self, believing one is not worthy of care, intensifying self-criticism
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use Self-deprecation phrasing (such as 'it is all I am not good enough'), low tone, reduced eye contact, shortened responses.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes exploring alternative explanations or gathering evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turns interpersonal distress into judgments of rules and logic to avoid contacting vulnerable emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use 'if... then...' logical deduction and fact listing, neutral tone, trying not to touch subjective emotion words.

manifestations: Living alone, with no immediate family members in the city
Feeling uncared for outside Work, not yet seen
Not yet sharing troubles with friends, insufficient emotional support mobilization
outcomes: Hard to relax after work; emotional burden grows

manifestations: Equates being recognized at work with personal worth, questioning own significance in the workplace
Experiences a drop in sense of meaning when praise is lacking
outcomes: Interpersonal interaction hindered; communication and cooperation affected

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Skeptical about change but willing to try, cautious pace
Frequent self-questioning (such as 'I am not worth his time')
In the session, focuses more on 'evidence / logic' than on the present subjective experience

positive_force: Likes and is engaged in one's own work, willing to maintain job satisfaction
Willing to try collecting evidence and exploring alternative explanations (openness)
Has a few friends as potential support resources
Able to clearly express troubles and goals, having Reflection ability
negative_force: Excessive reliance on external recognition to define self-worth (External Validation)
Negative cognitive patterns such as mental filtering, mind reading, and overgeneralization exist
Repeatedly recalling after Interacting with supervisor, Difficulty relaxing (rumination)
Self-deprecation and low self-worth leading to Decreased motivation, Interpersonal tension

target_behavior.behavior: Rumination and Self-deprecation after Interacting with supervisor, accompanied by Decreased motivation and tense emotions
antecedent: Interacting with the boss face-to-face or online
The boss assigning more challenging tasks but not yet giving praise
Trying friendly non-Work conversation but meeting brief or uninterested responses
target_behavior.core_reason: The unnoticed-birthday event triggering the core belief of 'I am not cared about', continuously Reinforced under cognitive patterns of mental filtering, mind-reading, overgeneralization
target_behavior.function: Reducing relationship uncertainty by presetting that others do not care, seeking external recognition to confirm self-worth
target_behavior.consequence: Work motivation and performance mildly affected; Relationship tension with the boss, hindered communication; Difficulty relaxing after work, Overall happiness lowered

target_behavior.behavior: Persistently tense and unable to relax outside work (repeatedly replaying interactions with the boss)
antecedent: Recalling interaction details with the boss after work or when Being alone
When thinking of scenes where the boss is busy or lacks recognition
target_behavior.core_reason: High uncertainty about whether the boss cares triggering Anxiety and Self-doubt, Reinforcement negative automatic thoughts
target_behavior.function: Maintaining vigilance to try to control Interpersonal relationships, preventing disappointment
target_behavior.consequence: Declining rest and relaxation quality, Increased emotional burden, affecting interactions with others and daily life
